prompt: Polished Roblox-style mining simulator, stylized 3D game render, mid-day sunlight with soft shadows, no UI, no text other than icons. Camera: third-person view from behind a small blocky miner with a pickaxe standing at the spawn, looking across the shaft and rig toward the two buildings.
